description: This file contains functions and configuration setup for DHCPv6 protocol using shell scripting. It includes initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown functions for DHCPv6, as well as configuration parameters and command execution logic.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 protocol configuration options and parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to the specified list.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 configuration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 for a given interface with specified configuration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Triggers renewal of DHCPv6 lease for a given interface.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Tears down DHCPv6 configuration for a specified interface.
